summary: User asks best practices for handling long-running workflow and activity spans in OpenTelemetry tracing. RunWorkflow and RunActivity spans remain open for hours/days, causing missing parent span errors in Jaeger/New Relic and memory issues. Also reports trace fragmentation when retry delays exceed ~90 seconds.
userImpact: Production observability becomes fragmented and unreliable when tracing long-running workflows and activities, with missing parent span errors and memory buildup preventing proper distributed trace analysis.
rootCause: RunWorkflow and RunActivity spans have extended lifetimes (hours/days) while child spans complete immediately, breaking parent-child span relationships in observability backends and causing memory management issues.
keyQuote: Because RunWorkflow and RunActivity spans last for a very long time, they remain open (not "ended") for hours or even days.
